input: Get a referral for a sleep specialist this month

gold.taskTitle: Get a Sleep Specialist Referral This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a referral to see a sleep specialist within the current month.

questions.title: Which doctor will you request the referral from?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a primary care physician, GP, or another provider who would issue the referral.

questions.title: What sleep issue is prompting this referral?
questions.description: Understand the specific symptom or condition driving the need, such as insomnia, suspected sleep apnea, or restless legs.

questions.title: Do you already have an appointment with your doctor?
questions.description: Determine whether the user still needs to schedule a visit with their referring physician or already has one booked.

questions.title: Does your insurance require a formal referral?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user's health insurance plan mandates a referral before seeing a specialist, or allows direct booking.

questions.title: Have you seen a sleep specialist before?
questions.description: Find out if the user has prior history with a sleep clinic or specialist that could affect the process or provider choice.

questions.title: Is there a specific clinic or specialist you prefer?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a preferred provider, location, or hospital network they want the referral directed to.

questions.title: What is your exact deadline within this month?
questions.description: Pin down whether the user means before the month ends, before a specific date, or within the next few weeks.
